thesis: The meaning of life is **choosing** to stay awake to each other and **building** something real from that attention.

imageHistory.prompt: A vast dark cosmos with swirling galaxies and stars, and at the center, a single luminous human eye opening wide, made of nebula gas and starlight, looking outward and inward at the same time, the pupil reflecting the same cosmos it sits within — recursive, glowing, alone, wondering.
imageHistory.motivation: The idea of the universe waking up and looking at itself is a strong visual metaphor — it captures the core insight vividly.

imageHistory.prompt: Two vast swirling nebulae in deep space slowly pulling toward each other, and where their gas clouds meet and merge, the luminous shape of two human hands reaching for each other forms from the starlight, one hand made of blue gas and one of gold, fingers almost touching, surrounded by newborn stars sparking at the point of contact, dark cosmos behind them.
imageHistory.motivation: The metaphor of love as conscious gravity is vivid and visual — two nebulae being drawn together transforming into two human figures reaching for each other, the cosmic and intimate scales merged.
